concept: A rooftop guardian chases a masked saboteur across a floating clocktower, only to discover that stopping him has accidentally activated the ancient weapon he was trying to disable.
story_outline: Open on Astra sprinting across the rotating exterior gears of a clocktower suspended above a neon city during a midnight festival. Ahead of her, masked saboteur Riven reaches the tower's central mechanism and pulls a glowing red crystal free. Astra assumes he is stealing the city's power core and intercepts him on the giant clock face with her cyan energy blade. Their brief duel sends sparks across the golden hands. Astra strikes Riven's wrist, knocking the crystal loose. It hits the clock face and cracks. The tower shudders, alarms surge, and a red countdown suddenly accelerates inside the crystal. As part of the clock face collapses beneath Astra, Riven fires a cable and catches her before she falls toward the city. Hanging between them, he shouts, 'It isn't a power core. It's a trigger.' Behind him, the clocktower unfolds into an ancient airborne weapon and begins charging a crimson beam aimed directly at the city. Astra sees the countdown and realizes her mistake. With seconds left, Riven uses his cables to hold a broken gear in place, opening a path toward the weapon's exposed lens. Astra runs across the tilted clock hands while Riven blocks a defensive blast, cracking his mask. He throws her the damaged crystal. Remembering how the crystal briefly absorbed energy from her blade during their duel, Astra locks it against the cyan blade and drives both into the weapon's lens. The crimson beam bends upward and erupts harmlessly into the storm, filling the sky with a vast cyan-and-red aurora. The tower begins to collapse. Riven loses his footing, but Astra catches him by the wrist, mirroring the way he saved her moments earlier. Below them, the festival lights return. End on Astra and Riven standing together on the damaged clock hand beneath the aurora, no longer enemies. Prioritize visible action, immediate cause and effect, and very short spoken lines. Do not use inner monologue or narration.
style: high-energy cinematic science-fantasy anime, monumental floating clockwork architecture, neon city far below, rain and sparks, sharp cyan versus crimson energy contrast, dynamic but readable action staging, clear visual cause and effect, limited floating debris for continuity, precise character silhouettes, dramatic wide shots mixed with expressive close-ups, visually repeat the wrist-saving gesture to reinforce the change from enemies to allies
